content.rendered: Come meet your student’s teacher and see your student’s classroom before school starts on Wednesday, August 27th. Meet & Greet is an open house style event and will be held on Monday, August 25th. Teachers and classrooms will be available to visit from 4:00 – 6:00 pm.
